deploy-bot: [staging] deploy started by alice — commit v2.3.7-rc4 (sha: abcdef12). Change window: 2026-03-21 23:00-23:45 UTC. Initial canary: 10% traffic -> plan to ramp to 100% over 20m. CI: all checks passed. Notifying on #eng-releases.

alice: launching, will watch canary dashboards and logs. tagging me for follow-ups. :rocket:

ben: i'll keep an eye on infra metrics (gpu utilization, qps, tail latency). ping if anything odd.

cara: pinning reranker to v2.3.5 for safety on staging routes, will unpin if all green.

deploy-bot: [staging] canary ramp -> 30% complete. Observability: latency median +7ms, error rate baseline. Reports: transient 500s from eu-west-1 node gpu-03 (3/300 requests). Auto-retries enabled.

devon: seeing a tiny spike in 5xx, looks like a worker OOM on gpu-03, digging in. please hold further ramps until i confirm.

ben: +1 hold. can we snapshot current canary state?

alice: holding ramp at 30% per @devon/@ben. triggering canary snapshot and starting investigation. rollback criteria: >1% 5xx sustained for 10m or latency p95 > 800ms.

deploy-bot: Snapshot created: staging-snap-20260321-171999. Traffic paused at 30% as requested by alice.

cara: posting quick logs from affected pod: ```
2026-03-21T23:08:11Z ERROR worker: OOM while allocating tensor
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/runtime/worker.py", line 412, in handle
    out = model.forward(batch)
```

devon: confirmed OOM pattern; temporary fix: reduce per-worker batch from 8 -> 4 on gpu-03 and restart replica. rolling restart initiated for gpu-03 pool.

ben: restarting done, gpu-03 replicas back up and serving. preliminary metrics look stable. error rate back to baseline after 2m.

alice: good catch. resuming ramp: 30% -> 60% over 5m, then monitor 10m before full. everyone stand by.

deploy-bot: Resuming rollout. New plan: 60% target in 5m. Will post updates every checkpoint.

deploy-bot: Checkpoint: 60% reached. p50/p95 within acceptable range, 5xx < 0.05%. No regressions on reranker.

cara: unpinning reranker; reverting to v2.3.7-rc4 for full traffic.

alice: shifting to 100% now. tagging release notes draft and updating changelog.

deploy-bot: [staging] rollout complete — commit v2.3.7-rc4 pinned to staging. Duration: 26m. Final checks: perf OK, errors within baseline. Change window closed. Release note: "improve KV cache handling and small reranker latency reduction".

bob: (note: bob is not in thread) :thumbsup:

ben: nice work. i'll follow up with a short postmortem of the OOM trigger and the batch-size mitigations.

alice: thanks everyone for quick responses. leaving monitoring on for one hour then archiving. :white_check_mark:
